REST API main¶

async main.read_root()¶

Returns a basic response from the root endpoint.

The endpoint is used to check whether the FastAPI application is running and accessible. Access to the endpoint is limited to a maximum of 5 requests within 10 seconds.

Returns:

A welcome message confirming that the application is running.

Return type:

dict

REST API routes Auth¶

async src.routes.auth.confirmed_email(token: str, db: Session = Depends(dependency=<function get_db>, use_cache=True, scope=None))¶

Confirms a user's email address using a verification token.

The token is decoded to retrieve the user's email address. The corresponding user is searched in the database. If the user exists and has not been confirmed yet, the email is marked as confirmed.

Parameters:

  • token (str) -- The email verification token.

  • db (Session) -- The database session.

Returns:

A message indicating the email confirmation status.

Return type:

dict

Raises:

HTTPException -- 400 if the verification token is invalid or the user cannot be found.

async src.routes.auth.login(body: OAuth2PasswordRequestForm = Depends(dependency=None, use_cache=True, scope=None), db: Session = Depends(dependency=<function get_db>, use_cache=True, scope=None))¶

Authenticates a user and generates access and refresh tokens.

The user's email and password are checked against the data stored in the database. The user must also have a confirmed email address. After successful authentication, new access and refresh tokens are generated and the refresh token is saved in the database.

Parameters:

  • body (OAuth2PasswordRequestForm) -- The OAuth2 form containing the user's email and password.

  • db (Session) -- The database session.

Returns:

Access token, refresh token and token type.

Return type:

TokenModel

Raises:

  • HTTPException -- 401 if the email is invalid.

  • HTTPException -- 401 if the password is invalid.

  • HTTPException -- 401 if the user's email is not confirmed.

async src.routes.auth.refresh_token(credentials: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials = Security(dependency=<fastapi.security.http.HTTPBearer object>, use_cache=True, scope=None, scopes=None), db: Session = Depends(dependency=<function get_db>, use_cache=True, scope=None))¶

Refreshes the access and refresh tokens using a valid refresh token.

The refresh token is extracted from the Authorization header, decoded and compared with the token stored for the current user. If the token is valid, new access and refresh tokens are generated and the old refresh token is replaced in the database.

Parameters:

  • credentials (HTTPAuthorizationCredentials) -- Authorization credentials containing the refresh token.

  • db (Session) -- The database session.

Returns:

New access token, refresh token and token type.

Return type:

TokenModel

Raises:

HTTPException -- 401 if the refresh token is invalid, expired or does not match the stored token.

async src.routes.auth.request_email(body: RequestEmail, background_tasks: BackgroundTasks, request: Request, db: Session = Depends(dependency=<function get_db>, use_cache=True, scope=None))¶

Sends an email confirmation message to a registered user.

If the user exists and their email is already confirmed, no new confirmation message is sent. Otherwise, the confirmation email is added to FastAPI background tasks.

Parameters:

  • body (RequestEmail) -- The request containing the user's email address.

  • background_tasks (BackgroundTasks) -- FastAPI background tasks used to send the confirmation email asynchronously.

  • request (Request) -- The current HTTP request used to obtain the application base URL.

  • db (Session) -- The database session.

Returns:

A message indicating that the confirmation email has been requested.

Return type:

dict

async src.routes.auth.reset_password(body: RequestEmail, background_tasks: BackgroundTasks, request: Request, db: Session = Depends(dependency=<function get_db>, use_cache=True, scope=None))¶

Requests a password reset for a registered user.

Searches for a user by email address. If the user exists, a password reset email containing a reset token is sent as a background task.

Parameters:

  • body (RequestEmail) -- The request containing the user's email address.

  • background_tasks (BackgroundTasks) -- FastAPI background tasks used to send the password reset email asynchronously.

  • request (Request) -- The current HTTP request used to obtain the application base URL.

  • db (Session) -- The database session.

Returns:

A message indicating that the password reset email has been requested, or an error message if the user does not exist.

Return type:

dict

async src.routes.auth.reset_password_confirm(token: str, body: ResetPassword, db: Session = Depends(dependency=<function get_db>, use_cache=True, scope=None))¶

Resets the user's password using a valid reset token.

The reset token is decoded to identify the user. The new password is hashed and saved in the database.

Parameters:

  • token (str) -- The password reset token.

  • body (ResetPassword) -- The request containing the new password.

  • db (Session) -- The database session.

A message confirming that the password was changed.

dict

Raises:

HTTPException -- 404 if the user associated with the reset token does not exist.

async src.routes.auth.reset_password_form(token: str)¶

Validates a password reset token and returns data required to create a new password.

The reset token is decoded to retrieve the email address associated with the password reset request.

Parameters:

token (str) -- The password reset token received by the user.

Returns:

A message, user's email and the reset token.

Return type:

dict

Raises:

HTTPException -- 400 if the token is invalid or expired.

async src.routes.auth.signup(body: UserModel, background_tasks: BackgroundTasks, request: Request, db: Session = Depends(dependency=<function get_db>, use_cache=True, scope=None))¶

Registers a new user in the system.

Checks whether a user with the specified email already exists, hashes the password, creates a new user in the database, and sends an email confirmation message in the background.

Parameters:

  • body (UserModel) -- The data required to create a new user.

  • background_tasks (BackgroundTasks) -- FastAPI background tasks for sending the confirmation email without blocking the response.

  • request (Request) -- The current HTTP request used to obtain the application base URL.

  • db (Session) -- The database session.

Returns:

Information about the successfully created user.

Return type:

UserResponse

Raises:

HTTPException -- 409 if a user with the specified email already exists.

REST API services Auth¶

class src.services.auth.Auth¶

Bases: object

Provides authentication and authorization functionality.

The class is responsible for password hashing and verification, creation and validation of JWT access, refresh, email confirmation and password reset tokens, as well as retrieving the current user.

ALGORITHM = 'HS256'¶
SECRET_KEY = 'secret_key'¶
async create_access_token(data: dict, expires_delta: float | None = None)¶

Creates a JWT access token.

The token contains the provided data, issue time, expiration time and the access token scope. By default, the access token is valid for 15 minutes.

Parameters:

  • data (dict) -- Data that will be stored inside the JWT payload.

  • expires_delta (Optional[float]) -- Custom token lifetime in seconds. If not specified, the token is valid for 15 minutes.

Returns:

Encoded JWT access token.

Return type:

str

async create_email_token(data: dict)¶

Creates a JWT token for email confirmation.

The token contains the provided data, issue time and expiration time. By default, the email confirmation token is valid for 7 days.

Parameters:

data (dict) -- Data that will be stored inside the JWT payload.

Returns:

Encoded JWT email confirmation token.

Return type:

str

async create_refresh_token(data: dict, expires_delta: float | None = None)¶

Creates a JWT refresh token.

The token contains the provided data, issue time, expiration time and the refresh token scope. By default, the refresh token is valid for 7 days.

Parameters:

  • data (dict) -- Data that will be stored inside the JWT payload.

  • expires_delta (Optional[float]) -- Custom token lifetime in seconds. If not specified, the token is valid for 7 days.

Returns:

Encoded JWT refresh token.

Return type:

str

async create_reset_password_token(data: dict)¶

Creates a JWT token for password reset.

The token contains the provided data, issue time, expiration time and a specific token type that identifies it as a password reset token. By default, the token is valid for 15 minutes.

Parameters:

data (dict) -- Data that will be stored inside the JWT payload.

Returns:

Encoded JWT password reset token.

Return type:

str

async decode_refresh_token(refresh_token: str)¶

Decodes and validates a JWT refresh token.

The method verifies the token signature and checks whether the token has the required refresh token scope. If the token is valid, the user's email is returned.

Parameters:

refresh_token (str) -- The JWT refresh token to validate.

Returns:

The email address stored in the token.

Return type:

str

Raises:

HTTPException -- 401 if the token is invalid, expired, or has an incorrect scope.

async decode_reset_password_token(token: str)¶

Decodes and validates a password reset token.

The method verifies the JWT signature and checks the token type to ensure that it was created specifically for password reset operations. If the token is valid, the user's email address is returned.

Parameters:

token (str) -- The password reset token.

Returns:

The email address stored in the reset token.

Return type:

str

Raises:

HTTPException -- 401 if the token is invalid, expired, or does not have the required reset password type.

async get_current_user(token: str = Depends(dependency=<fastapi.security.oauth2.OAuth2PasswordBearer object>, use_cache=True, scope=None), db: Session = Depends(dependency=<function get_db>, use_cache=True, scope=None))¶

Retrieves the currently authenticated user.

The access token is decoded and validated first. If the token contains a valid access token scope, the user's email is extracted from it. The user is then searched in Redis cache. If the user is not found in the cache, the database is queried and the user is saved to Redis for subsequent requests.

Parameters:

  • token (str) -- The OAuth2 access token provided by the client.

  • db (Session) -- The database session.

Returns:

The authenticated user.

Return type:

User

Raises:

HTTPException -- 401 if the access token is invalid, expired, has an incorrect scope, or the user cannot be found.

async get_email_from_token(token: str)¶

Extracts a user's email address from an email confirmation token.

The JWT token is decoded and the email address stored in the sub field is returned.

Parameters:

token (str) -- The email confirmation token.

Returns:

The email address stored in the token.

Return type:

str

Raises:

HTTPException -- 422 if the token is invalid or cannot be decoded.

static get_password_hash(password: str)¶

Creates a secure bcrypt hash for a password.

A new random salt is generated for each password before hashing it with bcrypt.

Parameters:

password (str) -- The plain-text password to hash.

Returns:

The bcrypt hash of the password.

Return type:

str

static verify_password(plain_password: str, hashed_password: str)¶

Verifies a plain-text password against a hashed password.

The plain password is encoded into bytes and compared with the stored bcrypt password hash.

Parameters:

  • plain_password (str) -- The password provided by the user.

  • hashed_password (str) -- The bcrypt hash stored in the database.

bool

REST API services Email¶

async src.services.email.send_email(email: EmailStr, username: str, host: str)¶

Sends an email confirmation message to a user.

Creates an email verification token, prepares an HTML email using the configured template, and sends the message through the FastMail SMTP service.

Parameters:

  • email (EmailStr) -- The email address of the user who should receive the confirmation message.

  • username (str) -- The username of the user who should receive the confirmation message.

  • host (str) -- The base URL of the application used to create the email confirmation link.

Returns:

None

Return type:

None

Raises:

ConnectionErrors -- If a connection error occurs while sending the email.

async src.services.email.send_reset_password_email(email: EmailStr, username: str, host: str)¶

Sends a password reset email to a user.

Creates a password reset token, prepares an HTML email using the password reset template, and sends the message through the configured FastMail SMTP service.

Parameters:

  • email (EmailStr) -- The email address of the user who requested a password reset.

  • username (str) -- The username of the user who requested a password reset.

  • host (str) -- The base URL of the application used to create the password reset link.

Returns:

None

Return type:

None

Raises:

ConnectionErrors -- If a connection error occurs while sending the email.
